title: nan
authors: Yan Y.; Zhang B.; Zhou J.; Zhang Y.; Liu X.
key_contribution: Presents a real-time localization and mapping system fusing wheel odometry, IMU, and VIO with ORB-SLAM2 for agricultural robots in GPS-denied greenhouse environments, validated experimentally.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
